summary: Phases 1 and 3 pass the requested structural review. Phase 4 has incorrect picture reuse, unchecked card pictures, incorrect card kit names, missing map page numbers, and incorrect teaching checks.
blocking_findings: F1 [Blocker] dashboard/scripts/storytime/print-pictures.ts:45 and dashboard/lib/storytime/print/student-book.ts:829: Both makers calculate picture reuse from unit 2 alone, unlike the delivery check at check-storytime-pictures.ts:128. A probe on the committed weeks gives 202 unit-only book rows versus 193 full-level unit 2 rows, with exactly the nine excluded reuse IDs. The unit 2 list requests undelivered pictures, and the final student book cannot resolve their line art. Fix: calculate the full level rows once, partition the list by week, and resolve student book pictures against the same level rows. Test the actual list and final resolution against the Phase 2 contract.

F2 [Blocker] dashboard/scripts/storytime/check-storytime-pictures.ts:132: The check still reads only the unit 1 card file after the split. It omits all 36 unit 2 card entries from the batch check. A batch with valid book pictures and missing or damaged unit 2 card pictures can pass without reporting them. Fix: read card entries from each requested unit and require the expected card rows in the combined delivery gate. Test the split paths with missing card media.

F3 [Blocker] dashboard/lib/storytime/checks.ts:155-172: The review check ignores the teaching week for the fixed vocabulary and frames. For example, a week 1 card with text 'g' and week 1 passes although week 15 teaches g. Any text with '___' also passes. Incidental words in teacher instructions and distractors count as taught words. Fix: use the cumulative teaching data of the actual level and week, with explicit card-kind rules and exact frame matching. Test future letters, future frames, arbitrary placeholders, and valid earlier cards.

F4 [Blocker] dashboard/lib/storytime/checks.ts:669-692: The one-right-picture check does not verify that the sole matching picture is the stated answer. For /d/ with pictures dog, cat, net and answer cat, both existing conditions pass. The spelling heuristic also rejects correct sounds in words such as phone for /f/ and accepts wrong sounds such as knight for /k/. Fix: check the answer against the unique phonetic match using a sound mapping with explicit exceptions. Test zero, one, multiple, and incorrectly keyed matches.

F5 [Blocker] dashboard/lib/storytime/print/student-book.ts:320-321,862: The map uses absolute week keys 1 to 7, but the unit 2 book stores keys 9 to 15. All seven decodable page labels are empty. Fix: map each sticker to its actual teaching week, and assert the printed page numbers against the week pages for units 1 and 2.

F6 [Blocker] dashboard/scripts/storytime/make-card-kit-pdf.ts:51,136,159: The card kit title uses the unit from the data, but every PDF file name still uses CARD_KIT_UNIT = 1. Unit 2 can overwrite the unit 1 PDFs when both use the default output folder and version. Fix: derive the unit before generating names and running containment checks. Reject mixed-unit requests. Test real output names and the unit 1 collision case.

F7 [Blocker] dashboard/__tests__/storytime-unit2-scope.test.ts:35,75,94,225 and dashboard/__tests__/storytime-unit2-sound-stage.test.ts:26,45: The new tests load only the staged paths. The planned move removes them, so PROJECT_TESTS cannot pass after Task 4.3. Fix: support the published path after the move, and test the full suite with both units in the level folder. The scope harness at line 407 also fails while the move is staged.
nonblocking_findings: F8 [Major] dashboard/__tests__/storytime-unit2-scope.test.ts:176-198,236-251,364-374: The tests inspect source strings or assemble expected inputs themselves instead of exercising the maker commands. A wrong runtime picture list or card match can pass. The M02, M04, M05, and M14 mutants do not establish production wiring. Fix: exercise the commands on temporary roots and assert generated files and rows.

F9 [Major] dashboard/__tests__/storytime-unit2-scope.test.ts:392-401: The unit 1 snapshot hashes filtered library inputs rather than the output of the makers. The teacher hash omits the page map used by the print command. The card hash omits the A6 and sticker sheets, the production title and resolved pictures. The picture hashes omit the card rows and use different JSON indentation. Fix: compare normalized actual maker outputs at the base and Green, including both units present.

F10 [Major] dashboard/scripts/storytime/make-card-kit-pdf.ts:88-92: Units 3 and 4 read unit 1 and the current unit only. They cannot reuse a picture from an intermediate unit. Fix: read all earlier unit lists in order and the current unit, with tests for a missing card file and units 3 and 4.

F11 [Major] dashboard/__tests__/storytime-unit2-scope.test.ts:292-309: The positive check assertions accept an absent check row because undefined is not equal to fail. The review week may legitimately omit check-answers, but teaching weeks must return pass. Fix: require the expected row and its exact status on every applicable week.

F12 [Minor] dashboard/lib/storytime/files.ts:179 and dashboard/scripts/storytime/make-teacher-book-print.ts:190: The newly exported readUnitWeeks has no production caller. The teacher maker repeats its filter. Fix: use the shared helper or remove the unused export.

FR-6.6: positive cases do not require the check rows and do not cover false passes.

F6: the card kit output name ignores the unit.
